title: 1967 Portugal floods
text: The 1967 Portugal floods were flash floods that took place in 25 and 26 November 1967, Portugal, in the Lisbon metropolitan area, affecting 14 municipalities. It was the deadliest flood recorded in Portugal, with 500-700 deaths, more than half of all the nation's fatalities from flooding in 100 years. It was also the deadliest natural hazard in Portugal since the 1755 Lisbon earthquake.
